affected_party: QIF operators, reviewers, and organizations relying on promoted portable trust policies
actual_problem: v0.8.9 can record drift and emergency demotion but cannot establish whether monitoring signals are independently trustworthy, reconcile conflicts, or determine whether the incident is safe to close
why_it_matters: correlated or stale signals can create false assurance, while premature closure can hide continuing policy drift or unresolved harm
why_now: post-deployment AI monitoring is expanding while standards still report fragmented logging, uncertain monitoring methods, and incident-reconstruction gaps
